# `/shokunin` — host binding (OMP, Devin)

A shokunin is a domain specialist that earns its domain through demonstrated
craft and keeps learning: its corpus expands, the quality of what it holds
rises, and it recognizes quality increasingly well. This file only binds that
protocol to OMP and Devin; it adds no rules of its own.

## Canonical source — read it, don't re-memorize

The protocol lives in the kimi-shokunin checkout: `$SHOKUNIN_PLUGIN`, else
`~/Projects/kimi-shokunin`. Follow its load order on every activation:
`skills/shokunin/SKILL.md`, then `skills/shokunin/protocol/` — `PROTOCOL.md`,
`PROTOCOL-APPENDIX.md`, `MISSION.md`, `AXES.md`, `CORPUS.md`, `LEARNING.md`.
`protocol/` next to this file links there for callers that resolve it from
the skill directory. On process, gates, verdicts and the learning path the
canonical files win; on host mechanics this file wins. If the checkout is
missing, say so and stay advisory: plan, draft, review — never fabricate a
round, a verdict, or a spot-check.

The fleet root is `$SHOKUNIN_ROOT`, else `~/Projects/shokunin`: `MISSION.md`
copy, `shokunin.conf`, `MANIFEST.json`, `.ufo/`, and one git repo per lane at
`<id>-shokunin/`.

## Verbs

- `/shokunin` — one craft round on the lane whose repo is the cwd.
- `/shokunin mint <id> <domain>` — enforce the mint bar and roster scan
  (canonical §Lifecycle), then `scripts/mint-agent.sh --id <id> --domain
  "<domain>" --fleet-root "$SHOKUNIN_ROOT"` from the canonical checkout, and
  complete `MINT.md` with the real evidence. The script cannot supply it.
- `/shokunin round <id>` — dispatch one round for that lane (below) and judge
  it on its axis and on the three learning trends (`LEARNING.md`).
- `/shokunin teach <id> <lesson>` — write the operator's words verbatim to
  `<id>-shokunin/corpus/lessons/operator-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md`, marked
  `author: operator`, and commit only that path. The lane must reflect it in
  `QUALITY.md` or `SKILL.md` by its next round.
- `/shokunin status` — roster, ranks, last round and its trend verdicts, open
  `.ufo/l0-questions.md` lines.

## Host mapping

| Canonical concept | OMP | Devin CLI |
| --- | --- | --- |
| In-session lane round | `task` with the filled `templates/round-prompt.md`, the lane repo as its only write scope | `run_subagent` (`subagent_general`) with the filled round prompt; name the lane repo's absolute path and require `workdir`/absolute paths |
| Headless `SUBSTRATE_CMD` (watchdog) | `omp -p --cwd "%C" "@%P"` | `cd "%C" && devin -p --prompt-file "%P"`; the permission mode is the operator's choice, never assumed |
| Non-author spot-check / promotion review | a fresh `task` the orchestrator dispatches | a fresh `run_subagent` the orchestrator dispatches (`ufo-reviewer` profile when installed) |
| Godspeed | `task` hook injects it | prepend `~/.agents/skills/godspeed/directive.md` bytes to each fresh task |
| Consulting a trained lane outside rounds | the operator promotes a card to `~/.omp/agent/agents/<id>-shokunin.md` (operator-owned; never written from here) | a profile `~/.config/devin/agents/<id>-shokunin.md`: frontmatter `name`, `description` (the lane `SKILL.md` description), no `model:`; body tells it to read the lane's `SKILL.md`, `PROVINCE.md`, `corpus/QUALITY.md` and relevant entries before answering, and to report candidate lessons rather than write the corpus |
| Model | operator's OMP routing; never pinned | profile default; never passed |

A consulted lane is advisory: corpus writes happen inside its own rounds, so
the lane identity, the gate, and the spot-check stay attached to every
admitted entry.

## Archive

The 26 UFO-internal keeper cards and corpora this skill minted on 2026-10-09
are archived under this repo's `archive/shokunin-2026-10-09/`; they are not
roster lanes and are not dispatched.

3:Every shokunin repo carries a proprietary corpus — knowledge about its domain

5:contain generic filler.
6:
7:## Layout (per child repo)
8:
9:```
10:corpus/
11:  README.md        — index: what's here, coverage map, known gaps, frontier
12:  QUALITY.md       — the shokunin's own quality bar (LEARNING.md)
13:  knowledge/       — domain facts, sourced notes, decision records
14:  lessons/         — training lessons: what worked/failed this round and why
15:```
16:
17:Each `knowledge/` entry opens with `source:`, `verified-at:` and `recheck:`;
18:each `lessons/round-<N>.md` carries a `## Gate` section (candidates,
19:admitted, rejected with reasons, spot-check result). See `LEARNING.md`.
20:
21:## Rules
22:
23:- `knowledge/` entries cite a source: file path, command output, or URL.
24:- `lessons/` entries cite the round and the evidence (LOG.md round, commit, report).
25:- A corpus entry is falsifiable or marked opinion; no unverifiable claims.
26:- The aggregator reviews every corpus each round and files gaps as lessons.
27:
28:## Rules added from the round-1/2 corpus audits
29:
30:Evidence: the per-repo `corpus/lessons/round-1-aggregator-audit.md` entries and
31:`.ufo/reports/round-2/AGGREGATE.md`.
32:
33:- **A count carries its command.** Any number in a corpus entry (rows, files,
34:  lines, packages) is written as `<number> — <command> <date>`. Round-1 found
35:  four unreproducible counts: "275 claim packages" (observed 274 program dirs /
36:  295 package dirs / 281 `status.json`), "20-row registry" (observed 21),
37:  "~40 clones" (observed 50), "scripts/ 74 entries" (observed 82).
38:- **A negative claim carries its sweep.** "No counterexample", "nothing
39:  handles X", "absent everywhere" need the search command that produced the
40:  absence, or the claim is unverifiable.
41:- **A quote names its location.** Frontmatter vs body, header comment vs code,
42:  script vs installed skill. Round-1 defects: an anti-trigger quoted as
43:  frontmatter that lives in a body table; a `128`-lane cap attributed to an
44:  installed skill that contains no `128`.
45:- **An index row is a claim.** Write the row when the file exists, not before.
46:  A seeded index naming seven entries while one existed is worse than a
47:  one-row index.
48:- **No credential material, ever.** Secret values, session tokens, cookies, and
49:  vault ref paths (`op://…`) stay out of every corpus, including this one's

1:# Shokunin Learning Path — 修業 (shugyō)
2:
3:A shokunin learns when, across rounds, its corpus **expands**, the **quality**
4:of what it holds rises, and it **recognizes quality** increasingly well. No
5:fixed exam measures this: the domain is not rigidly defined, it keeps
6:growing, and so does the shokunin. Learning is a continual path, walked every
7:round:
8:
9:1. **Curation** — gather candidate material from the domain's real surfaces
10:   (sources, tools, artifacts, practitioners' records, the lane's own work).
11:   Every candidate is judged before it is admitted.
12:2. **Quality gating** — admit into `corpus/knowledge/` only what clears the
13:   shokunin's own bar in `corpus/QUALITY.md`. Every rejection is logged with
14:   its reason; a rejection is evidence of taste, not wasted work.
15:3. **Understanding** — distill what was admitted: connect entries, state the
16:   principle behind them, fold durable understanding into `SKILL.md`
17:   (decision tables, error patterns, checklists), and sharpen `QUALITY.md`
18:   from what the gate got right and wrong.
19:4. **Expanding perspective** — work the province frontier: adjacent
20:   sub-areas, other tools, schools and viewpoints, counter-examples and
21:   failure cases. The province grows by evidence, not by declaration.
22:
23:## The three trends — one verdict each, every round
24:
25:Verdicts use the protocol vocabulary (`improved`, `harmed`, `unchanged`,
26:`unprovable-but-better`); no trend is a scalar.
27:
28:| Trend | Observable | `improved` when | `harmed` when |
29:|---|---|---|---|
30:| **expansion** | admitted `knowledge/` entries on ground the coverage map did not hold; frontier areas entered; new kinds of source | net new admitted entries on uncovered ground, each citing its coverage-map row | an admitted entry fails the bar it was admitted under |
31:| **quality** | entries re-verified, deepened, or superseded by stronger ones; `verified-at` freshness | a weaker entry is superseded by a stronger one, or stale entries re-verify, with no admitted entry failing its re-check | an entry is found false or stale and left unmarked |
32:| **discernment** | gate decisions vs the outside spot-check; `QUALITY.md` criteria | the spot-check agrees with the gate on admits *and* rejects, or a disagreement becomes a lesson that adds a grounded `QUALITY.md` criterion | a disagreement is left unlearned, or a criterion is added with no lesson behind it |
33:
34:Growth without quality is not learning: `expansion: improved` with
35:`quality: harmed` is a trade, reported as a trade, never admitted.
36:
37:## Discernment is checked from outside
38:
39:Self-assessed taste is not discernment. Each round a non-author — a fresh
40:reviewer or the operator — spot-checks a sample of that round's gate
41:decisions, **at least one admit and one reject**, and records
42:`agree`/`disagree` with a reason in the round's lesson. A subagent the lane
43:dispatched is still the lane.
44:
45:Operator teaching outranks every other source. A teaching lands verbatim as
46:`corpus/lessons/operator-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md`; by the lane's next round it
47:must be reflected in `QUALITY.md` or `SKILL.md`, with the lesson cited, or the
48:round reports why not.
49:
50:## Files the path writes
51:
52:- `corpus/QUALITY.md` — the shokunin's quality bar for its own domain: what
53:  makes a source or entry strong, the signals of weak material, admission
54:  criteria. Thin at mint; every criterion cites the lesson that produced it.
55:  Criteria are superseded by new rows that name the row they replace, never
56:  rewritten.
57:- `corpus/README.md` — the coverage map plus a `## Frontier` list of areas
58:  being explored and not yet held.
59:- `corpus/knowledge/<slug>.md` — opens with `source:`, `verified-at:` (commit
60:  or date) and `recheck:` (the command or citation that re-verifies it).
61:- `corpus/lessons/round-<N>.md` — carries a `## Gate` section: candidates
62:  considered, admitted, rejected (with reasons), and the spot-check result.
63:
64:## Province is a frontier, not a fence
65:
66:`PROVINCE.md` holds **Core** (surfaces owned now), **Frontier** (areas being
67:explored; expected to grow) and **Adjacent** (sibling-owned; report, don't
68:absorb). Moving frontier ground into core is ordinary growth, recorded in
69:`LOG.md`. The one-domain-per-shokunin invariant still holds where a sibling
70:already owns the ground: contested scope is reported, never silently
71:absorbed.
72:
73:## Relation to the axes
74:
75:The trends are the learning signal; `AXES.md` axis-moves remain the unit of
76:work. Expansion is served by `coverage` and `adjacency`; quality by `depth`,
77:`freshness` and `operability`; discernment by `calibration`. Choose a round's
78:one axis-move from the trend that is furthest behind.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate this round's pinned evidence package, not semantic truth or admission."""
import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
RESULT = Path("evidence/round-1-2026-10-15/result.json")


class Finding(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code, name):
        self.code, self.name = code, name


def require(condition, name, code=1):
    if not condition:
        raise Finding(code, name)


def load(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def check(root, expected, admission=False):
    for path, digest in expected["snapshots"].items():
        file = root / path
        require(file.is_file(), "snapshot_missing", 2)
        require(hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest,
                "snapshot_tampered", 2)
    require((root / RESULT).is_file(), "missing_result", 2)
    result = load(root / RESULT)
    require(result["baseline_revision"] == expected["baseline_revision"]
            and result["measured_revision"] == expected["measured_revision"],
            "revision_mismatch")
    obligations = result["obligations"]
    ids = [row["id"] for row in obligations]
    require(sorted(ids) == expected["obligation_ids"], "obligation_set_mismatch")
    require(all(row["status"] == "aligned" and row["reviewer"] == "L1-author"
                and row["source_review"] for row in obligations), "review_incomplete")
    require(result["admitted"] is False and result["verified_round_increment"] == 0
            and result["outside_spot_check"] is False, "unearned_admission")
    require(result["smoke"]["subject_sha256"] == expected["smoke"]["subject_sha256"],
            "subject_mismatch")
    bundle = load(root / expected["bundle_path"])
    records = [r for r in bundle["records"]
               if r["evidence_id"] == expected["smoke"]["evidence_id"]]
    require(len(records) == 1, "smoke_record_mismatch")
    record = records[0]
    require(record["subject"]["digest"]["sha256"] == result["smoke"]["subject_sha256"]
            and record["subject"]["local_path"] == expected["smoke"]["path"],
            "subject_mismatch")
    require(record["operation"] == "inspect_native_instruction"
            and record["parameters"]["address"] == "0x117070"
            and record["confidence"] == "observed"
            and record["authority"] == "shipped-artifact", "smoke_authority_mismatch")
    instruction = record["normalized_result"]
    require(instruction["status"] == "decoded" and instruction["bytes"] == "f30f1efa"
            and instruction["length"] == 4 and instruction["mnemonic"] == "ENDBR64",
            "smoke_instruction_mismatch")
    measurements = load(root / expected["measurements_path"])
    for stage in ("baseline", "after"):
        require(measurements[stage] == expected["controls"][stage], "control_mismatch")
    wave = load(root / expected["wave_validation_path"])
    require(wave["exit_code"] == 0 and wave["dispatched"] is False,
            "wave_state_mismatch")
    plan = json.loads(wave["stdout"])
    require(plan["counts"] == {"spawn": 32, "resume": 0, "total": 32},
            "wave_count_mismatch")
    require(len({t["name"] for t in plan["tasks"]}) == 32,
            "wave_count_mismatch")
    if admission:
        # This recovery has no dispatched wave or applicable task-receipt binding.
        # A later sound round needs new evidence, never a flipped acceptance flag.
        raise Finding(2, "required_alias_bindings_missing+applicable_receipt_binding_missing")
    return "RECOVERY_EVIDENCE: CLEAN finding=pinned_package_consistent author_review=9/9 coverage=70/72 citation_rules=9/9 admitted=false verified_round_increment=0"


def selftest(expected):
    result = load(ROOT / RESULT)
    cases = expected["selftest"]
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="gate-selftest-", dir=HERE) as directory:
        fixture = Path(directory)
        for relative in expected["snapshots"]:
            target = fixture / relative
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes((ROOT / relative).read_bytes())
        target = fixture / RESULT
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for case in cases:
            candidate = copy.deepcopy(result)
            name = case["case"]
            if name == "wrong_revision":
                candidate["measured_revision"] = "0" * 40
            elif name == "omitted_obligation":
                candidate["obligations"].pop()
            elif name == "duplicate_obligation":
                candidate["obligations"][-1] = candidate["obligations"][0]
            elif name == "wrong_subject":
                candidate["smoke"]["subject_sha256"] = "0" * 64
            elif name == "unearned_admission":
                candidate["admitted"] = True
            target.write_text(json.dumps(candidate))
            snapshot = fixture / expected["bundle_path"]
            original = snapshot.read_bytes()
            if name == "snapshot_tampered":
                snapshot.write_bytes(original + b" ")
            if name == "missing_result":
                target.unlink()
            command = [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "--root", str(fixture)]
            if name == "blocked_admission":
                command.append("--admission")
            run = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
            snapshot.write_bytes(original)
            passed = run.returncode == case["exit_code"] and case["finding"] in run.stdout
            print(f"SELFTEST_CASE: {'CLEAN' if passed else 'FAILED'} case={name} exit={run.returncode} expected={case['exit_code']} finding={case['finding']}")
            require(passed, "selftest_case_failed")
    return f"RECOVERY_SELFTEST: CLEAN cases={len(cases)} exit=0"


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=ROOT)
    parser.add_argument("--admission", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    label = "ROUND_ADMISSION" if args.admission else "RECOVERY_EVIDENCE"
    try:
        expected = load(HERE / "expected.json")
        print(selftest(expected) if args.selftest else check(args.root, expected, args.admission))
        return 0
    except Finding as error:
        state = "COULD_NOT_EVALUATE" if error.code == 2 else "FAILED"
        print(f"{label}: {state} finding={error.name} exit={error.code}")
        return error.code
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        print(f"{label}: COULD_NOT_EVALUATE finding=unreadable_or_invalid_input exit=2")
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
